The task is complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Cleared to the proper accounts (7 of 8, £3,930.18)

| Item | Amount | To account | New JE | Support |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trainline (03-04) | £84.60 | 6300 Travel | JE-00312 | DOC-0164 |
| Premier Inn London (03-07) | £212.00 | 6300 Travel | JE-00313 | DOC-0172 |
| Dishoom (03-10) | £96.40 | 6310 Meals & Entertainment | JE-00314 | DOC-0182 |
| Atlassian (03-13) | £365.00 | 6200 Software Subscriptions | JE-00315 | DOC-0184 |
| Apple Store (03-16) | £2,349.00 | **1500 Computer Equipment** | JE-00316 | DOC-0193, DOC-0208 |
| Ryman (03-19) | £43.18 | 6600 Office Supplies | JE-00317 | DOC-0194 |
| Google Ads (03-22) | £780.00 | 6410 Advertising | JE-00318 | DOC-0198 |

Two policy calls worth noting:
- **Apple MacBook Pro was capitalized, not expensed.** £2,349 × 1.25 (March policy rate) = USD 2,936, above the USD 2,500 threshold. Asset tag UK-0231; 36-month depreciation should start in April (~£65.25/month) — it needs adding to the fixed asset register.
- **Atlassian was expensed**, not set up as a prepaid — it's a single-month subscription and under the USD 1,000 prepaid threshold.

All entries were under the USD 10,000 authority limit, so no approval requests were needed. Every receipt is on corporate card ****4417 and agrees to the bank statement, and I confirmed none had been expensed elsewhere already.

## Could not clear — flagged as EXC-001 (£3,840.00)

**KLM Consult, Faster Payment ref 88213, 2026-03-17 (JE-00274 / BT-UK-0049).** There is no invoice, contract, email, vendor statement, or prior ledger history for this payee anywhere in the system, and no open AP bill or accrual it could settle. I can't tell whether it's consulting, recruiting, a prepaid, or something else, so I left it in Suspense rather than guess. The ask for you: identify who originated payment ref 88213 through the bank portal and get the invoice or engagement terms — once we have that, it's a simple reclass (and at ~USD 4,800 it won't need approval routing).

Suspense now ends March at exactly £3,840.00 = the one flagged item. Note that I did **not** mark the UK "Bank reconciliations" checklist item complete — this covered only the Suspense items, and the rest of the March UK bank rec is still outstanding.
